title: Gemini Enterprise — Secure Adoption, Guardrails & Data-Access Boundaries
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Adopt Gemini Enterprise without opening your data
problem: Gemini Enterprise is only safe if it respects the enterprise data-governance model — grounding answers in the right data and nothing more. This solution establishes secure Gemini Enterprise adoption: the technical guardrails, data-access boundaries, and governance alignment so AI can only see what it should, use cases align to policy, and security/legal are satisfied — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Gemini Enterprise governance model: how grounding/data access works, the guardrails, and how adoption aligns to the enterprise data-governance model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Gemini/Workspace licensing, data-governance baseline incl. sharing/DLP, security/legal stakeholders, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Implementation Guide — exact steps to set the technical guardrails and data-access boundaries, align use cases to policy, remediate oversharing that AI would surface, validate on a pilot, then expand.
5 supporting scripts — AI-readiness/oversharing discovery, per-scope guardrail validation, an access-boundary/coverage report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for safe, compliant AI adoption; Gemini preview capabilities are cited or flagged, never invented.
short: Establish secure Gemini Enterprise adoption — technical guardrails, data-access boundaries, and governance alignment — so AI only sees what it should and use cases fit policy, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Establish secure Gemini Enterprise adoption — technical guardrails, data-access boundaries, and governance alignment — so AI only sees what it should and use cases fit policy, pilot-first.
